preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be at least 2, and the sum of edge weights s must be at least 1.
The input must contain exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative real number representing the minimum possible diameter, which cannot exceed the total sum of edge weights s.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= weight for weight in edge_weights) and sum(edge_weights) == s
postconditions.description: There exists a valid assignment of non-negative real weights to edges such that their sum equals s, and the diameter of the weighted tree is equal to the output value.
The output is the minimum possible diameter achievable by any valid assignment of edge weights summing to s.
